title: Auxiliary Clues Aware's Geometry Problem Solving
abstract: arXiv:2611.30617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Geometry Problem Solving (GPS) serves as a rigorous test of the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), particularly when solutions require auxiliary constructions absent from the input diagram. However, explicit diagramming methods suffer from unstable image generation quality and cascading errors, while existing implicit attention mechanisms primarily focus on visible elements, limiting their ability to support reasoning that requires additional geometric constructions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{AuxCA} (Auxiliary-Clues-Aware GRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that helps models learn transferable auxiliary-construction strategies that can be applied beyond the training domain without explicit diagram generation at inference time. translated_title: 辅助线索感知的几何问题求解
translated_abstract: 几何问题求解是多模态大语言模型复杂推理能力的一项严格测试，尤其当求解过程需要输入图形中并不存在的辅助构造时更是如此。然而，显式作图方法存在图像生成质量不稳定和级联错误的问题，而现有的隐式注意力机制主要关注可见元素，限制了其支持需要额外几何构造的推理能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了**AuxCA**（辅助线索感知GRPO），这是一个强化学习框架，能够帮助模型学习可迁移的辅助构造策略，使其在推理时无需显式图形生成即可应用于训练领域之外。具体而言，我们引入了辅助线索依赖度（**ACD**）来量化辅助视觉线索对token生成的影响……
tldr: 提出AuxCA强化学习框架，通过辅助线索依赖度（ACD）量化辅助视觉线索的作用，使多模态大模型学会可迁移的辅助构造策略，在推理时无需显式作图即可提升几何问题求解能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes AuxCA, a reinforcement learning framework with Auxiliary Clues Dependency (ACD) that enables MLLMs to learn transferable auxiliary-construction strategies for geometry problem solving without explicit diagram generation at inference time.
